testcase.name: Scenario: Select an assembly template in list view: tmp/obk-gallery2/features/application/document-creation/document-creation.feature:151:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select an assembly template in list view ✔ Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the metric template folder is selected ✔ And templates are grouped by type ✔ When the user chooses List in the template display menu ✔ Then the gallery displays compact template entries under type headings ✔ And the template details pane remains visible ✔ When the user selects the standard metric assembly template in the list ✔ Then the details pane identifies an assembly with millimeter units ✔ When the user chooses Medium icons in the template display menu ✔ Then the gallery displays medium-sized template icons ✔ And the details pane continues to identify the metric assembly template
